runs.purpose: Mirror the dataset owners' Google Drive folder, without the 360 GiB depth.tar.gz that Table 5 does not use, to /datasets/bosphorussign22k; verify against Drive's MD5s; write a SHA-256 manifest.

terminal.detail: Stopped by the agent after 6.5 minutes. rclone had copied 248 small files (about 1 file per second) and reported 163 of 10,187 queued transfers with an estimated two weeks remaining, far beyond the 24-hour ceiling. A disposable diagnostic (app ap-53FTl2zoWkIbbT9cg4esbf) copied 26 to 32 files of the same kind in 2 to 3 seconds from a fresh container, to local disk and to the Volume alike, so neither Drive downloads nor Volume writes are slow in themselves. Working hypothesis, refuted by populate-dataset-2: the per-folder listing of 22,542 folders in each of three trees consumed the Drive request quota that the transfers share.

runs.observed: Files copied before the stop stay on the Volume and are skipped by the retry. No manifest was written.

runs.purpose: Retry of populate-dataset-1 with one change: rclone lists the folder with a single recursive listing (--fast-list) and 8 checkers instead of 16.

terminal.detail: Stopped by the agent after 5.5 minutes: 221 files copied, 197 of 10,213 queued transfers, estimated 11 days remaining. The single recursive listing changed nothing, so the listing hypothesis of populate-dataset-1 is refuted. A local download of 434 files with debug logging then showed the cause: 97 responses 'rateLimitExceeded' on the quota 'defaultPerMinutePerProject' of drive.googleapis.com. The login uses rclone's shared Google client ID, whose request quota is shared by all rclone users; rclone backs off on every such response. Throughput therefore depends on a credential, not on code.

runs.observed: Files copied before the stop stay on the Volume and are skipped by a later attempt. No manifest was written.

runs.purpose: Download HGR2A, HGR2B (downscaled and full-size archives) and the Rendered Handpose Dataset from their official pages to /datasets/hgr2a, /datasets/hgr2b and /datasets/rendered-handpose-dataset; keep the archives, extract them, write SHA-256 manifests.

gates.reason: BosphorusSign22k is distributed on request under an end user licence agreement that forbids transfer to third parties without the licensor's authorization. The queue record's license, permission_to_reproduce and on_modal fields are empty. The videos show signers' faces. The dataset is absent from the shared Modal Volume 'datasets'.

gates.reason: The Drive login stored as Modal Secret 'gdrive-rclone' uses rclone's shared Google client ID. Google rate-limits that client's project, which limits the copy to about one file per second: 67,000 remaining files would not finish within the 24-hour ceiling, and one attempt remains.
